sections.text: Introduction

This document outline the equipment 
inspection checklist I3, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

Turbine bearing is located up to the hub and is the first bearing from the 
bottom of the unit under the thrust bearing

This bearing function is to carry the radial water 
force component and to keep the shaft vertically.

This document is initiated and tested by eng. Ahmed Abd El Kader Mahmoud, 
accepted by eng. Atty Seiffen general manager, and approved by eng. Mohamed 
Abd El Baset Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1&2 PS and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.
The unit must be stopped and dewatered
The oil circulation pumps must be off
Gate lock and break on

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Wrenchs and indicator
Work to be Carried Out

Monitor oil condition when 
a change of oil is nessecery the entire system should properly be cleaned. The new oil 
should be filtered to seventy microns or better before its put into the oil 
system

Check the thermo signal 
bulb if it is in its place or not

Check the tightening of all 
visual parts into the bearing
Change the coupling rubber

Clean the strainer of the 
oil

Clean the heat exchanger 
by reversing the pass of the water circulation
